summary: Your nineteenth Sunday review. You answer 9 questions on request ids, tokens, cost, NULL versus 0, medians and the 2 a.m. list with a confidence number, fill in your five numbers with what each hides, extend your glossary, find one request in every place that holds its id, add an operations sentence to your applications, tag week 19 and plan week 20.
goal: Self-test, error log (3 themes), catch-up slot, plan next week.

items.text: Self-test: answer the 9 questions with a 1 to 3 confidence number, then mark each one
Fill in your five numbers and what each one hides
Glossary: add 9 new words with a one-line definition and an example
Run it from cold and find one request by its id in every place
Count this week's applications and add a sentence about operating the system
Run git tag week-19, then plan week 20 with an outcome sentence, a drop list and 3 to 5 applications
Play the LLMOps Mix-up game to the end and see your score
